listen: Good morning. This is The Daily Brief for Monday, October 12, 2026. The lead story: actor RJ Mitte has died at age 34. Mitte lived with cerebral palsy. He played Walter White Jr. in the Emmy-winning drama series Breaking Bad. Now the front page. Ukraine's leader says Russia has hit six energy sites since President Trump announced an energy ceasefire. In India, authorities have removed more than 130 million names from the voter roll, and protests are growing. Nearly 22 million dollars in taxpayer funds has been spent on ads, with nearly half spent after Trump said his super PAC would fund them. Immigration agents searched the home of congresswoman Ilhan Omar. She said the search was an attempt to target political enemies. Now, one short sentence for each section. Tech and AI: Python 3.15 is out, and Anthropic is expanding its Cyber Verification Program. Politics: Katie Zacharia will become the White House press secretary. The Justice Department is investigating TV networks for possible antitrust violations. World: Opposition parties marched to India's top court. Crews are being offered large rewards to transit the Strait of Hormuz. Sports: Brendan Allen won a fifth-round submission over Christian Leroy Duncan. San Francisco 49ers linebacker Dre Greenlaw was suspended one game. Atlanta: Trump will campaign in Dalton on Friday with Mike Collins and Rick Jackson. Brookhaven residents asked the council to delay a fire station agreement. Architecture: Matterport now accepts registered E57 point cloud files. IES Sync for Revit has launched. Science and Nature: Antarctic sea ice reached its 2026 maximum, the third lowest on record. Coast redwoods slow their photosynthesis in heat. A First Nation-led effort is replanting kelp in Clayoquot Sound. That is the brief. Have a good day.

lead.title: Breaking Bad actor RJ Mitte dies aged 34
lead.note: Actor RJ Mitte has died at age 34, according to the BBC World report. Mitte lived with cerebral palsy and was known for playing Walter White Jr. in the Emmy-winning drama series Breaking Bad. The summary is brief and does not give a cause of death or other details. Mitte's role made him one of the best-known young performers of the show's run. His death is a personal loss for many viewers of the series. The story is a short, straightforward report of a death and his career.
